shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge (experimental), "Traveler" climb animations, blueprint art, wall risers, research-gated links, a per-colony off switch, Perspective Shift + Toggleable Overlays support. Window 11 SHIPPED to Workshop 3776015553. Window 12: cross-level ability/jump targeting (§82) and band-aware range/target overlays (§83) both built and field-verified, unshipped.

**NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 SUPERSEDED by §62; §31 publishing + GIT; §32-40 records; §41-44 combat/senses/travel/CE; §51 Celestial Lighting; §52 field-report round 2; §53 arrival/landing; §54 structure fit; §55 exit grid; §56 Geological Landforms; §57 stale decoration window; §58 relocated-structure fog; §59 forbid-aware islands; §60 area-linear vanilla systems; §61 camera-mod coexistence; §62 utility COLUMN rework + §62.N; §63 stairs permission; §64 cross-level shadow depth; §65 forbidden mirroring; §66 aim/wild-miss/aim-pie; §67 boulder extrusion; §68 KCSG/VFEM2; §69 stair temperature; §70 band flora legality + §70.B (OPEN); §71 Smooth Terrain (RESOLVED; report awaiting paste); §72 link gizmos; §73 transit animations (SUPERSEDED); §74 blueprint art; §75 wall risers; §76 Perspective Shift; §77 motion study + §77b railing bug + §77c art defects; §78 pre-hop delay + climb grammar; §79 Toggleable Overlays; §80 research gating; §81 multiple-levels checkbox; **§82 cross-level ability/jump targeting (FIELD-VERIFIED)**; **§83 band-aware range + target overlays (FIELD-VERIFIED, partial scope - see §83.7)**. Keep every ⚠.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> **⚠⚠ V1 SOURCE IS NOT GONE. DATED SOURCE BACKUPS LIVE AT `D:\Rimworld\As above, So below\<yyyymmdd-hhmmss>\Source\`** (ten snapshots, newest `20260726-154207`). The old note "V1 survives only in git history pre-a50a744" was WRONG and cost a re-derivation. These are `Source/` only - no Defs, no Textures. **When a V2 feature has a V1 ancestor, READ THE V1 FILE FIRST.** Confirmed useful: `Source/Stairs/ClimbAnimation.cs` (§78d). Tool boundary: `read` refuses that path, `bash`/`grep`/`sed` reach it fine.

# 0. START HERE

**CURRENT PHASE: BUILD MODE, WINDOW 12 OPEN. NOTHING IS IN FLIGHT.**

**WINDOW 12 HAS TWO FINISHED, VERIFIED, UNSHIPPED FEATURES: §82 (run #375) and §83 (run #376).** Both came out of one user field report about jumps and psycasts. Neither is committed as a release yet; **a publish decision is the natural next move**, and it would be the first chance to close the workshop smoke test (ledger 1) on a build we already trust.

**WINDOW 11 IS SHIPPED** to Workshop 3776015553; pushed as **`93a8311`**; post-restore build green.

**⚠ WORKSPACE DLL IS A DEBUG BUILD** (`build_mod` builds Debug). Re-run `dotnet build -c Release` in `Source/` before any publish.

**⚠ THE ONE THING NO WINDOW HAS EVER DONE: THE WORKSHOP SMOKE TEST.** Every verification to date, §82 and §83 included, has been against the WORKSPACE copy; nobody has ever subscribed to the uploaded item and loaded it. A file that exists locally but was never uploaded would pass every check this project has ever made.

**⚠ OPEN, NOT URGENT:** **FINAL riser art** (Gemini PAUSED r5; ⚠ REWRITE prompts to the REAL palette - NO copper: power=steel+blue+hazard, pipe=pale+red valve, climate=ice+louver+orange, data=black+purple+cyan; the 12 shipped riser PNGs are placeholders by explicit user decision). **§77c ART** - grand staircase east/west sprites unrotated; user's domain. **ABOUT.XML DESCRIPTION IS STALE** (no research gating, no off switch) - USER'S COPY, flagged not fixed. **`About/known-issues.json`** has shipped unchanged since window 8.

**⚠ SHIPPED KNOWINGLY UNVERIFIED (earlier windows, still true):** §62.N, §70 (w8); §62.M, §66c, §66e (w7).

**⚠ USER WORKING RULES:** (1) NEVER source design ideas from other mods unless asked - scans COMPAT ONLY. **V1 is OUR OWN prior work and is exempt: porting from it is explicitly wanted.** (2) Building art = USER via Nano Banana kits. (3) About.xml description = USER's copy. (4) N mockups = N CHOICES.

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE FIFTY-THREE RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS. 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX. 18 (§57a): NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 (§57f): `TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME. 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY "IS THIS MAP READY" GATE. 21 (§58): THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT. 22 (§59): A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT. 23 (§60): AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL. 24 (§61a): CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR. 25 (§61b): A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED. 26 (§61f): EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE RENDERER'S "IS IT DRAWN" GATE - selectable is drawable, and so is **highlightable** (§83). 27 (§62c): PREFER SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 (§63a): A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE. 29 (§0b): REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS. 30 (§66d): A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER. 31 (§66f): MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED. 32 (§69a): TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT. 33 (§62k): A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO. 34 (§62l): AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER. 35 (§62n): A CLONED FOREIGN DEF MADE VISIBLE IS IN NONE OF THE HOST'S OWN LOOKUPS. 36 (§70a): RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE. 37 (§71a): NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. 38 (§73): WHEN A SPRITE MUST APPEAR AWAY FROM ITS THING'S POSITION, OWN THE DRAW. 39 (§76): WINNING THE LAST WRITE DOES NOT SETTLE A DISAGREEMENT ABOUT THE TARGET. 40 (§75.h): A TRIPWIRE THAT FIRES BEFORE THE OBSERVER ATTACHES IS NOT A TRIPWIRE. 41 (§77a): A STRUCT FIELD YOU NEVER SET IS A FEATURE YOU NEVER SHIPPED. 42 (§77b): THE DIRECTION A MOTION READS AS IS A PROPERTY OF THE THING, NOT OF THE ARRIVAL. 43 (§78): **DEFER THE MOVE, NEVER THE DECISION.** 44 (§78b): AN OFFSET APPLIED WHOLE ON FRAME ONE IS A TELEPORT. 45 (§78d): **A DIRECTION OF TRAVEL IS NOT A DIRECTION OF ELEVATION.** 46 (§78d): **NON-UNIFORM SCALE x ROTATION = SHEAR.** 47 (§79): **A FOREIGN MOD'S CACHED CURSOR CELL IS AN ASSUMPTION ABOUT COORDINATE SPACE.** 48 (§81a): **A WRITE THAT IS READ BACK BY ITS OWN CALLER IS NOT A WRITE.** 49 (§0c): **A TEST THAT PROVES FEATURE A SAYS NOTHING ABOUT FEATURE B, AND "TESTS GOOD" IS NOT A SCOPE.** 50 (§82a): **TWO OF OUR OWN PATCHES ON ONE VANILLA METHOD CANCEL SILENTLY.** Harmony hands a POSTFIX the arguments AS THE PREFIX LEFT THEM. **GREP OUR OWN `[HarmonyPatch(...)]` LIST FOR THE TARGET METHOD BEFORE ADDING A PATCH TO IT.** 51 (§82b): **A FACTORY HAS USUALLY CONSUMED ITS INPUT BY THE TIME THE POSTFIX RUNS.** `PawnFlyer.MakeFlyer` despawns the pawn before returning it; capture in a PREFIX via `__state`. 52 (§83a): **AN OVERLAY MUST ASK THE SAME QUESTION THE CLICK WILL ASK, AND IT MUST NOT BE A QUESTION THAT WRITES.** A drawing-only copy of a reachability rule is §14's two-resolvers bug with a delay fuse - but `Verb.CanHitTargetFrom` is the wrong way to avoid it, because our own shoot-line patch ends in `ABCombatRelay.RecordSolution` and a ring evaluates thousands of cells. Call the pure solver that sits *under* the patch. **Observers do not write.** 53 (§83c): **A PREDICATE PASSED IN IS CLOSED OVER THE ARGUMENTS THE CALLER ALREADY HAS.** Moving a centre/root in a prefix while the caller's lambda still refers to the old one draws the right shape from the wrong maths - so only relocate an argument when the companion delegate is null, or replace the whole method.

# 82. CROSS-LEVEL TARGETING FOR JUMPS, ABILITIES AND PSYCASTS — **FIELD-VERIFIED, run #375**

**⚠⚠ 82a. TWO PATCHES ON `GenUI.TargetsAt`, CANCELLING (rule 50).** A window-8 PREFIX in `ABUIGeometry.cs` rewrote `clickPos` down a band; the window-9 POSTFIX in `ABCombatTargeting.cs` substituted the yielded CELL. Vanilla resolves THINGS from `clickPos` but the bare CELL from `UI.MouseCell()`, so the prefix could only fix the thing half - and Harmony hands the postfix the already-descended `clickPos`, which resolves as solid floor, so it declined. Every cell-targeted verb (jump packs, `Verb_CastAbilityJump`, Skip's destination, location psycasts) landed on the raw sky cell, where `ValidJumpTarget` refuses open air and `Verb_Jump.OnGUI` draws the red `TexCommand.CannotShoot`. **The prefix is DELETED and tombstoned. Do not reinstate it.**

**82.2** `TryResolveClicked` moved from `ABGuard.Combat` to `ABGuard.Rendering`: "which cell am I pointing at" is a DRAWN question, and the combat guard's blast radius was far larger than the fault deserved.

**⚠⚠ 82b. `PawnFlyer.MakeFlyer` DESPAWNS THE PAWN BEFORE IT RETURNS (rule 51).** The arc patch was a lone postfix opening `if (!pawn.Spawned) return;` - taken on every call since window 8, never once run. Now a PREFIX capturing `Origin __state` plus a postfix that applies it.

**82.3 NOT COSMETIC, WHICH IS WHY IT READ AS "PATHFINDING".** `RecomputePosition` ends `base.Position = groundPos.ToIntVec3()`, so the flyer's REAL cell walks the lerp - the pawn was genuinely dragged a Slot across the gutter and every level between; and `flightDistance` feeds `ticksFlightTime`, so it also took tens of seconds. Both corrected. Reproducing `overrideStartVec ?? pawn.TrueCenter()` in the prefix means an overridden start (PitBurrow, fleshbeasts) is translated too.

**82.5 AUDITED, ALREADY CORRECT** (do not re-derive): `JobDriver_CastJump` is `JobDriver_CastVerbOnceStatic` - `StopDead` then cast, never paths; `Toils_Combat.GotoCastPosition` bails on a cell target and otherwise routes through our `CastPositionFinder` prefix; `JumpUtility.OrderJump` calls `BestOrderedGotoDestNear` with `reachable: false`, which `Patch_RCellFinder_ABOrderedGotoBand` exempts.

# 83. BAND-AWARE RANGE AND TARGET OVERLAYS — **FIELD-VERIFIED, run #376** (partial scope, §83.7)

All in `Source/V2/ABRangeOverlay.cs`. §82 fixed what the player can POINT at; this is what the player can SEE about it.

**83.1 THE AI QUESTION, ANSWERED FIRST BECAUSE IT CHANGED THE SCOPE.** *"Will AI be able to use jump packs across levels?"* **No - and nothing in this mod is why.** Grepping the whole decompiled assembly for `Verb_Jump|JumpUtility|CastJump|JumpRange` returns seven files (`JobDefOf`, `JumpUtility`, `PawnFlyer`, `StatDefOf`, `Verb_Jump`, `Verb_CastAbilityJump`, `JobDriver_CastJump`) and **not one JobGiver, ThinkNode or AI file**. The jump-pack verb is `onlyManualCast=True`, and both jump ABILITIES (Biotech `Longjump`, `LongjumpMech`) leave `aiCanUse` false, which `Ability.AICanTargetNow` refuses on. Raiders never jump on a flat map either. Ledger 3.

**83.2 THE THREE GAPS.** (1) `Verb_Jump.DrawHighlight`'s white ring is a raw radial disc in the caster's band, so it stops at the lip of a hole even though the cells below are legal. (2) `VerbProperties.DrawRadiusRing` - every weapon, turret, psycast and placement preview - has the same shape and the same gap. (3) The target box (`GenDraw.DrawTargetHighlightWithLayer`) and the AoE circle (`GenDraw.DrawRadiusRing`) are drawn at the target's REAL coordinates, one Slot off the bottom of the screen for a below-band target.

**⚠⚠ 83a. THE PREDICATE RULE (rule 52).** The overlay asks the SAME question the click will ask: the jump ring calls `JumpUtility.CanHitTargetFrom` (the method §ABBandLeap prefixes) and the verb ring calls `ABCombatV2.TrySolve` (the body of the shoot-line patch). **But NOT `Verb.CanHitTargetFrom`** - that funnels into `Patch_Verb_ABCrossBandShootLine`, which ends with `ABCombatRelay.RecordSolution`: it PARKS a solution for the next `Projectile.Launch`. A ring evaluates thousands of cells, so it would park thousands and the next real shot could consume the wrong one.

**83.3 ONE REACH SET, THREE CONSUMERS.** `ABRangeOverlay.ReachSet` walks `GenRadial` around the caster's column **translated into the view band**, asks the shared see-through resolver what each column SHOWS, and judges that cell - same-band by vanilla's own rule, cross-band by the solver. Every candidate returned is a VIEW-BAND cell, so `GenDraw.DrawFieldEdges` draws the outline where the player is looking and the below half merges seamlessly with the in-band half. Radial radius `range` is a valid bound because the solved distance is never less than the horizontal separation.

**83.4 THE COSTS.** Vanilla recomputes its ring EVERY FRAME with a line-of-sight predicate; ours is cached on (map, kind, root, view band, range, minRange, verb, jumper) and refreshed every **30 ticks OR 120 frames** - the frame backstop because `TicksGame` does not advance while PAUSED, which is when dev-mode terrain edits happen. Cross-band solves capped at **`MaxCrossBandTests` = 4000 per paint**; when it bites the in-band half is still complete and `truncated` counts it (rule 33). ABShaft's six counters are **snapshotted and restored around every paint** so a ring cannot swamp `AB2: combat report` - legal only because §36 forbids any decision from reading them.

**83.5 THE BAND CLAMP IS ALSO A BUG FIX.** Candidates outside the view band or in the gutter are dropped. Vanilla's disc is raw cell space, so a caster within one range of the band's top row has its ring reach over the gutter into the level above; the impassable gutter usually blocks the sight test and hides it, but on a map whose band height is an exact slot multiple the gutter is zero rows and the ring bleeds onto another floor.

**⚠ 83c. THE LIFT PATCHES ONLY FIRE WHEN THE CALLER PASSED NO PREDICATE (rule 53).** `GenDraw.DrawRadiusRing`'s lambda is closed over the ORIGINAL centre. `TryLiftCell` gates all three lift patches and insists `shown == c` - it asks the renderer's own resolver what the column displays and requires that exact cell, so nothing under a solid floor is ever highlighted. Bands ABOVE the view are refused outright (see-through rendering is downward-only).

**⚠ 83.7 WHAT RUN #376 DID AND DID NOT PROVE (rule 49).** The run was a sky-band jump-pack session on a 3-band quicktest map with the isolated modlist (Core + DLCs + target + bridge). Structurally covered: the **jump ring** extending across open air, ring/click agreement, the **target box** lift, and frame rate under the worst-case scan. Structurally NOT covered and still open: the **AoE circle** (needs a psycaster with a radius ability), the **turret/mortar range ring viewed from another band**, the **`truncated` cap** (4000 solves is more than a 3-band sky map asks for), and **any interaction with Perspective Shift or Toggleable Overlays**, neither of which was in the session although both draw through the patched GenDraw entry points. Ledger 2 and 5.
